description: Publishes a webinar or takes it offline again: `status` publish or draft. Side effect: on publish the registration page and the room are public and can be found, on draft participants see nothing and registrations stop; it writes on the connected WordPress site. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars and `status`. `confirm` must be true, and only after the host has clearly agreed. Nothing else on the campaign changes and no page is rebuilt. Report the status the answer reads back (published or draft), never the one you asked for.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said yes to this status.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

status.description: publish makes the webinar public, draft takes it offline.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_visibility
title: Publish or unpublish a webinar
